core_obligations: Set up K-injective representatives: replace K by a K-injective complex on X', resolve g'_! of it by a K-injective complex on X, and recall the 4-term construction of the exchange map from the proof of lemma-shriek-proper-and-open (proof lines 3089-3102).

Lift across the base change: choose a K-injective resolution of the pullback of the original complex to X'_1 and pick the homotopy-commutative square of quasi-isomorphisms on X_1 whose equality arrow is justified by lemma-proper-f-shriek; write the second exchange arrow by the same 4-term chain (proof lines 3103-3128).

Prove compatibility of the identifications with pullback: reduce from g_!, g_{1,!}, g'_!, g'_{1,!} to the corresponding star functors using that shriek is a subfunctor of star with base change maps defined compatibly (see the proof of lemma-base-change-f-shriek-separated), then conclude by the Sites stacking remarks that the diagram of complexes commutes (proof lines 3129-3152).

Finish the remaining squares: the square comparing (a')^{-1} and J_1 is manifest, and the final 2x2 diagram commutes in the derived category by the choice of maps made earlier (proof lines 3153-3175).
proof_roadmap: K-injective setup and recall of the exchange map construction (proof lines 3089-3102).
Base change lift via the homotopy-commutative square (proof lines 3103-3128).
Shriek-to-star reduction and Sites stacking commutativity (proof lines 3129-3152).
